summary: New hire console access stalls: Okta session cookie domain mismatch after SCIM group sync
description:
Issue summary:
A newly onboarded engineer (internal account) cannot complete login to the Redwood Console. Login appears to succeed at Okta but the console stalls on initial load and immediately redirects back to the SSO flow. Session does not persist.

Impact:
- A single new hire (engineering) cannot access prod console resources needed for first-day tasks.
- Potential onboarding delay and manual provisioning overhead.

Observed timeframe:
- First reported 2026-03-12 09:34 PDT. Intermittent repro observed across multiple browsers for the user.

Steps to reproduce (from reporter):
1) User clicks "Sign in with Okta" on console.redwood.ai
2) Okta authentication completes; Okta redirects back to console callback with SAML assertion
3) Console initiates session creation but immediately redirects back to Okta login page (loop)

Observed behavior:
- Browser shows successful Okta SSO redirect (SAML assertion accepted).
- Console response sets a session cookie with domain=.redwood.ai but browser rejects it due to domain mismatch (console served from console.prod.redwood.internal).
- No console session appears in auth logs for the user.

Expected behavior:
- After Okta assertion, console should persist session and land on /home for the user. SCIM group membership should populate RBAC roles without additional steps.

Temporary workaround applied:
- Identity team manually created a console session for the user and assigned explicit roles in the DB so the user can proceed while we investigate.
investigation_notes:
Timeline and diagnostics:
- 2026-03-12 09:40: Support received user's browser HAR and screenshots.
- 2026-03-12 10:05: Reproduced in staging by QA with an account reproing an identical redirect loop.
- 2026-03-12 11:12: Captured request/response headers from console callback endpoint (see log snippet).
  - Callback set-cookie: session=eyJ...; Domain=.redwood.ai; Path=/; Secure; HttpOnly
  - Browser console: 'Cookie "session" rejected because domain "console.prod.redwood.internal" does not match ".redwood.ai"'
- Hypothesis: A recent change to the IDP proxy (PR 5421) added an override setting for cookie domain. When console is routed through our internal proxy (prod namespace), the cookie domain should be console.prod.redwood.internal but proxy is setting .redwood.ai. This mismatch causes browsers to reject the session cookie and the app to re-trigger SSO.
- Correlated with INT-523412 (electron client SSO cookie issue) which pointed at similar cookie path/domain regressions after proxy tweaks.
- Attempted mitigations run:
  - Rolled back cookie-domain override in staging proxy config -> repro stopped in staging.
  - Applied a one-off session entry for the affected user in production DB to restore access (manual workaround).

Next steps:
1) Identity infra to audit proxy cookie-domain config across prod clusters and align with service hostnames.
2) Patch PR in infra repo to only set cookie domain when host header matches public domain; otherwise use host-specific cookie domain. Link to draft PR: https://github.com/redwood/infrastructure/pull/5439
3) Plan a targeted deploy to prod with fallback and canary.
4) Add automated smoke test covering SSO flow and cookie acceptance for internal hostnames.
